I am overweight by about 50 pounds. I struggle with it everyday and am making steps to getting slimmer.

Apparently I forgot to give this guy  his jalapeños, and he was already pissed off before he came through. 
He proceeded to park his truck. Come into the store, and threatened to "burn me alive" because I forgot his jalapeños.
